epic.title: EPIC-30 : Replace primary market with an explicit AI insights language field in the Brand & Country step
epic.functionalNeed:
As a user setting up an analysis, I want to explicitly choose the language of my AI insights in the Brand & Country step, instead of having it implicitly derived from a primary market, so that I clearly understand and control the language in which AI-generated content is produced across the app.
- Remove the primary market concept from the setup flow - no country is implicitly treated as the one driving the insights language.
- Add a clearly labeled "AI insights language" field to the Brand & Country step.
- Add a tooltip on the field explaining that the selected language will be the language of all AI-generated insights: In-brief summaries across the app (including the corporate reputation graph) and the key concepts graphs (brand territory and themes sentiment).
- The selected language applies consistently to every AI-generated insight in the analysis: In-brief summaries wherever they appear (including the corporate reputation graph), brand territory, and themes sentiment.
- The AI insights language is set at the analysis level: within the same organization, each analysis can have its own insights language.

stories.title: [Frontend] AI Insights Language — Wizard Step 1 & Manage Scope (Story 30.2)
stories.userStory:
**As** a user configuring a GEO analysis,
**I want** to explicitly select the language in which my AI insights will be generated,
**so that** I fully understand and control the language of all AI-generated content in my analysis (in-brief summaries, brand territory, themes sentiment).

---
stories.acceptanceCriteria:
**AC1 — Language selector visible in Wizard Step 1**

- Given: I am on the Brand & Country step of the wizard (new analysis)
- When: the step loads
- Then: I see an "AI insights language" field with a language dropdown and a tooltip icon

**AC2 — Tooltip content**

- Given: I hover or click the tooltip on the "AI insights language" field
- When: the tooltip opens
- Then: I read that this language covers: in-brief summaries across the app (including corporate reputation graph), brand territory, and themes sentiment

**AC3 — Default language = my platform language**

- Given: my platform interface is set to French
- When: I open the wizard Brand & Country step for a new analysis
- Then: "French" is preselected in the AI insights language dropdown

**AC4 — Language list: full list + market languages pinned**

- Given: I open the AI insights language dropdown
- When: the dropdown opens
- Then: I see the full supported language list; the languages of my added markets are pinned at the top

**AC5 — Language selection commits immediately (no modal in wizard)**

- Given: I am in the wizard (new analysis)
- When: I select a different language
- Then: the selection is applied immediately with no confirmation modal

**AC6 — Language independent from country selection**

- Given: I change a market's country or language
- When: the change is applied
- Then: the AI insights language field is NOT automatically updated

**AC7 — Language sent in wizard submit payload**

- Given: I complete the wizard and submit
- When: the report is created
- Then: the selected `insightsLanguage` is included in the creation payload

**AC8 — AI insights language visible in Manage Scope**

- Given: I open Manage Scope on an existing report
- When: the scope view loads
- Then: I can see the current AI insights language for this analysis

**AC9 — Language editable in Manage Scope with confirmation modal**

- Given: I am in Manage Scope
- When: I select a different language and confirm in the modal
- Then: the new language is saved and the Manage Scope view reflects the change

**AC10 — Confirmation modal explains the impact**

- Given: I change the AI insights language in Manage Scope
- When: the confirmation modal appears
- Then: it explains that existing insights will be re-generated at the next scheduled analysis run

---

Key files: `insightsLanguages.ts`, `InsightsLanguageSelector.tsx`, `InsightsLanguageChangeModal.tsx`, `useUpdateInsightsLanguage.ts`, `useWizardStore.ts`, `Step1Content.tsx`, `useSubmitReport.ts`, `ManageScopeView.tsx`, i18n 4 locales. Remove `?lang=` from in-brief API calls.

stories.title: [Backend] AI Insights Language — DB, API & Pipeline (Story 30.1)
stories.userStory:
**As** a developer building the GEO platform,
**I want** the backend to store and expose an `insights_language` field at the report level, and use it throughout the AI text generation pipeline,
**so that** every AI-generated insight (in-brief summaries, brand territory labels, themes sentiment labels) is consistently produced in the language explicitly chosen by the user for their analysis.

---
stories.acceptanceCriteria:
**AC1 — **`insights_language` persisted on report creation

- Given: an Editor creates a new analysis via the wizard
- When: the wizard submits the configuration
- Then: the `insights_language` value selected in Step 1 is stored on the report and returned in the report detail and scope responses

**AC2 — **`insights_language` editable on existing reports

- Given: an Editor opens Manage Scope on an existing report
- When: they change and confirm the AI insights language
- Then: the new value is persisted immediately and returned in subsequent scope responses

**AC3 — In-brief summaries produced in **`insights_language`

- Given: an analysis has `insights_language = "fr"`
- When: any user (regardless of their own UI language) views an in-brief summary for that report
- Then: the summary text is in French

**AC4 — In-brief language is fixed per analysis**

- Given: two users with different UI languages viewing the same report
- When: they both open the in-brief summary
- Then: both see the same language — the report's `insights_language` — not their respective UI languages

**AC5 — Perception concepts extracted in **`insights_language`

- Given: an analysis has `insights_language = "es"`
- When: the enrichment pipeline extracts perception concepts after batch completion
- Then: the concept names (brand territory labels, themes sentiment labels) are in Spanish

**AC6 — Each analysis has its own **`insights_language`

- Given: an organisation with two analyses — one `insights_language = "en"`, another `insights_language = "fr"`
- When: both analyses complete
- Then: in-brief summaries and concept labels are in English for the first, French for the second
